name: WdMoveFromTextMark
description: Marks the moved-from text when text in a document with tracked changes is moved from one place to another.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkDoubleStrikeThrough
constants.description: Marks moved text with a double strikethrough.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkStrikeThrough
constants.description: Marks moved text with a strikethrough.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkCaret
constants.description: Marks moved text with a caret.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkPound
constants.description: Marks moved text with a pound (number) sign.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkNone
constants.description: No special formatting for moved text.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkBold
constants.description: Marks moved text with bold formatting.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkItalic
constants.description: Marks moved text with italic formatting.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkDoubleUnderline
constants.description: Marks moved text with a double underline.

constants.name: wdMoveFromTextMarkColorOnly
constants.description: Marks moved text with color only. Use the MoveFromTextColor property to set the color of moved text.
